U501.why: LAN8670 PHY moved north of the trunk (D16, user 2026-11-03: short, matched stubs; either port may be the used one): line pins 30/31 on its south edge centred on the trunk's midpoint x 155.0, 9 mm north of it; RMII leaves its west, north and east edges toward U401 (36 mm body to body, plan's 25 mm intent exceeded, on D16).

FL501.why: Common-mode choke straight under U501's line pins (rot 270: PHY side 1/2 north, line side 4/3 south). Its P winding is on the west and U501's P pin on the east, so the pair crosses once between FL501 and U501 (pinouts; one line hops to F.Cu). Nothing else under it (AN1718 2.0).

C511.why: DC block on T1S_P under the trunk: pad 2 directly below the F.Cu trunk (one via is the whole tap), pad 1 1.9 mm from FL501 pin 4; mirror of C512 about x 155 (DEC-012 rev. B).

C512.why: DC block on T1S_N, mirror of C511 about x 155: PHY stub P and N 12.5 mm each by construction (t1s_stubs.py).

C514.why: Termination centre-tap capacitor to GND between the trunk and K501, at the centre tap's two resistors.

D501.why: ESD on T1S_P at J903's pins, unchanged (AN1718 2.0). J912 has none: D16-2.

D502.why: ESD on T1S_N beside D501, unchanged.

Q501.why: Relay coil driver (reset coil), south of K501 outside the line zone, within 8 mm of it.

Q502.why: Relay coil driver (set coil), south of K501.

R501.why: RBIAS (12.4 kΩ) at U501 pin 26, in the line zone's north-east corner, clear of the choke.

R503.why: REFCLK series resistor (33 Ω) between Y501 and U501 pin 27.

R504.why: RMII REF_CLK series resistor at Y501's output, toward U401.

R516.why: 1.5 kΩ P drop leg, west of K501 beside pin 2.

R517.why: 49.9 Ω P termination leg, west of K501 beside pin 4 (P_END).

R518.why: 1.5 kΩ N drop leg, east of K501 beside pin 7, mirroring R516.

R519.why: 49.9 Ω N termination leg, east of K501 beside pin 5 (N_END), mirroring R517.

Y501.why: 50 MHz oscillator east of U501, outside the line zone so its clock stays off the T1S chain; UNDER_Y501 keeps foreign nets out from under it.

C509.why: VDDAU 10 nF at U501 pin 25, B.Cu: the top side there is under both connectors' housings.
